name: Generator
description:
``generator`` has several distinct usages.

+ Yield generator: a function or method that uses ``yield``, implicitly returning an instance of ``\Generator`` and implementing the ``Iterator`` interface without the boilerplate of writing one
+ Random number generator: an algorithm or function, such as ``rand()``, ``mt_rand()``, or the ``Random\Engine`` classes, that produces a sequence of numbers that appears random
+ Code generator: a tool or library that automates the creation of boilerplate PHP code from templates, configuration, or a schema

Absent further context, ``generator`` most often refers to the yield generator.
